name: Takikawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takikawa city emblem in yellow: a lozenge divided into three diagonal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Takikawa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1971; the emblem dates from 1 March 1948.

features.role: Takikawa city emblem — a lozenge divided into three diagonal bars
